text:
Ian: Heads-up — NovaBank POC hitting persistent 429s during a bulk import. Demo starts in ~20m, customer blocked. Can SE/SRE swarm?
Julie: On it. Which endpoints are erroring and roughly how many parallel requests? Any sample logs?
Sam: They run two workers: /v1/embeddings (batch=512) + /v1/chat/completions streaming. ~50 parallel workers total, roughly 180 rps combined. Client retries exponential backoff. 429s started ~15:02 UTC.
Sam: Paste of the tail logs we got from their sandbox:
```
2024-06-15T15:02:12Z ERROR request_id=abc123 status=429 route=/embeddings tenant=novabank reason=per_route_quota_exceeded
x-redwood-rate-limit: route=embeddings limit=20rps burst=40 window=60s
2024-06-15T15:02:13Z ERROR request_id=abc124 status=429 route=/chat/completions tenant=novabank reason=per_route_quota_exceeded
x-redwood-rate-limit: route=chat limit=30rps burst=60 window=60s
```
Julie: That looks like per-route reservation limits. Sales reserved chat=25rps for the demo but embeddings apparently has no reservation — default is low (20rps). Running 180rps will blow past both.
Ian: Ugh. We thought reservations covered both routes. Sam — did the presales ticket include embeddings?
Sam: No, only chat was requested in the initial request form. Embeddings was an ad-hoc load during import. Customer assumed shared quota.
Leo: I can push a short-term capacity bump for novabank. Quick CLI for an emergency override if you want to copy: 
```
redwoodctl capacity assign --tenant novabank --route embeddings --sustain 80 --burst 200 --until 2024-06-15T18:00:00Z --reason "presales demo emergency"
redwoodctl capacity assign --tenant novabank --route chat --sustain 80 --burst 200 --until 2024-06-15T18:00:00Z --reason "presales demo emergency"
```
Leo: Note this will increase spend for the tenant for the bump window.
DeployBot: Scheduled capacity bump for tenant=novabank at 2024-06-15T15:10:00Z by Leo. Reminder: temporary overrides are auditable and billable.
Julie: Great. Also suggest we ask the customer to throttle client parallelism while we do the bump: reduce workers -> 8-10 and embeddings batch -> 128. That will reduce token churn and avoid a second bump.
Ian: I'll message them to pause the import for 3 minutes while you apply the bump.
Sam: Also enabling per-request tracing header and token accounting will help us see which calls are heavy. Add header: `X-Redwood-Trace: <uuid>` and enable token-accounting in their sandbox.
Julie: I'll open a quick runbook PR to ensure presales requests include embeddings when import/ETL is planned — default to reserve both chat+embeds for presales tenants.
Leo: After bump applied, monitor logs. If 429s persist, we may need to reduce concurrency or add a short-lived dedicated slot. I'll watch dashboards.
Sam: For troubleshooting reference, here's the snippet of the rate limiter debug we use: 
```
rate_limiter.check(tenant=novabank, route=/embeddings) -> remaining=0 next_reset=43s window=60s
quota_state{route=embeddings, sustain=20, burst=40, used=82}
```
Ian: Customer confirms they paused import. Proceed when ready.
DeployBot: Capacity bump started at 2024-06-15T15:10:12Z for tenant=novabank (embeddings:+60 sustain, chat:+50 sustain).
Julie: :thumbsup: please confirm when 429s stop.
Leo: I see request success rate climb immediately after bump. 429s dropped to zero within ~30s. Monitoring for 10m to ensure stable.
Sam: I've asked customer to lower workers to 12 and batch to 128 for the demo. They agreed.
Ian: Thanks team — I communicated the billing note to customer. Please leave the override until EOD and we'll revert unless there's a need to extend.
Julie: Action items: (1) Julie — PR to presales runbook to include embeddings reservation checklist, (2) Leo — revert override by 2024-06-15T23:59 if no extension, (3) Sam — verify token-accounting traces and attach sampling to the POC ticket, (4) Ian — confirm demo resumed and capture customer feedback.
Leo: I'll set an automatic revert reminder.
Ian: Demo resumed and customer reports demo flow is green, 429s gone. :tada:
Julie: Filing a short post-demo note for the account — presales checklist updated.
Sam: I'll keep an eye on usage and open a follow-up if we need a longer-term reserved plan.
Ian: Great job — closing the swarm. :pray:
